setup.purpose: verbose CME errors — firmware returns bare ERROR otherwise

serving.notes: Returns LTE or NR5G-SA/NSA serving cell. Field order differs by RAT. No-SIM state returns empty OK (not an error).

neighbor.notes: Returns intra-frequency and inter-frequency LTE neighbors. Spelling is neighbourcell (singular).

full_scan.notes: 3 = LTE+NR. Mixed NR5G/LTE rows with MCC/MNC. 60-120 s. The actively-camped cell may be omitted from results (known Quectel quirk).

plmn_scan.notes: 3GPP operator scan. Slow — always use the full 180 s timeout and bail on no-op.

band_config.notes: SDX62 divergence from RM500Q: band read/force moved to AT+QNWPREFCFG. AT+QCFG="band" returns ERROR on this family.

endc.notes: NR EN-DC state readout. Optional capability probe; returns +QENDC: 0 on LTE-only attach.

known_broken.notes: SIMCom command — not present on Quectel SDX62 firmware.

diag.port: Lowest USB interface (if00) on the modem's USB device. capture_cell_diag auto-detects it by matching the IMEI from an AT probe on a sibling port; diagport=<path> overrides.
diag.notes: Code set mirrors DIAG_TARGET_CODES in capture_cell_diag/diag_config.c (the single source of truth): LTE ML1 serving 0xB193, LTE RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB0C0, LTE ML1 idle neighbors 0xB192, LTE ML1 connected neighbors 0xB195, LTE ML1 per-cell measurement 0xB17F (per-cell RSSI with RSRP/RSRQ), NR5G RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB821, NR5G ML1 measurement DB 0xB97F. 0xB825 (NR5G RRC configuration info) is intentionally omitted: nci-only, not a mappable measurement. GNSS position 0x1476 (LTE ML1 / gpsOne position report) and 0x14D8 (GNSS engine state) complete the set: the capture helper turns 0x1476 into a gps_fix and geo-tags every cell_observation from it. 0x14D8 is subscribed but yields no position (its parser hardcodes lat/lon/alt to 0.0 and no firmware populates those bytes), so it contributes engine state only. This list documents intent; the device decides what is actually subscribed, because diag_config_filter_supported narrows the shared set to each modem's advertised subset at handshake time. 0xB17F is emitted with version byte 5, including on a SIM-less PCIe/MHI unit. 0xB197 (LTE ML1 serving cell information: per-cell DL bandwidth RB + Tx antenna ports) is emitted by RM520N-GL R03A04 with version byte 2 (matching EG25-G/LM960/RM500Q) while the unit is moving. The trigger is mobility, not SIM presence: a stationary SIM'd unit emits none across an AT+CFUN=4->1 re-camp or connected-mode AT+CGACT PDP-activate cycles, even while 0xB193 and 0xB195 flow, so a stationary unit reading 0 is not a missing capability.
